name: Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler
summary: At Dreadmist Peak, druids gather water from a tainted pool to learn what is sickening the northern Barrens wildlife. The sample may help Tonga Runetotem find a cure.

sections.title: Tracing the Blight
sections.body: Dendrite Starblaze suspects the pools atop Dreadmist Peak are tied to a sickness afflicting gazelles and troubling the northern Barrens. The pools influence the weather, and he fears they are spreading the blight. So he sends druid initiates up the mountain with empty samplers to draw water. The Burning Blade, a demon-worshipping cult, now infests the heights.

sections.title: A Crucial Specimen
sections.body: Druids carry the empty sampler to the pool atop Dreadmist Peak and collect its water. Then they take the sample to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads. He can use it to devise a cure and protect the native wildlife.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler?
aliases: why do i have this sampler
faq.answer: Druids use the Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler, an empty Cenarion vessel, to draw water from the tainted pool atop Dreadmist Peak. They bring the sample to Tonga Runetotem to help him devise a cure for sickened wildlife.

faq.q: Where does this sampler need to be taken?
aliases: where do i fill the sampler
how to fill empty dreadmist peak sampler
faq.answer: Carry the sampler to the high pool atop Dreadmist Peak, northwest of the Crossroads in the Barrens, and draw a water sample.
Dendrite Starblaze provides the sampler on behalf of the Cenarion Circle. He then sends the druid to coordinate with Tonga Runetotem.

faq.q: Why is the water on Dreadmist Peak so important to sample?
faq.answer: The pools atop Dreadmist Peak influence regional weather and mist. The Burning Blade cult has corrupted the summit, and tainted runoff spreads across the plains, poisoning local creatures.

angles.text: As a druid, you use this vessel to collect a sample and learn to cure poisons, diagnose suffering in the wild, and ease it.
As a member of the Horde, you carry this sampler to aid Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads as he works to stop ecological decay across the northern Barrens plains.
